digest.component_or_area: live-DC readiness and Jira field provisioning
propositions: The live-DC readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 but does not verify that plugin-provided custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, creating a timing gap where readiness is declared before fields exist.

Both the harness workflow (conftest.py:127-140) and probe workflow (jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py) use the weak serverInfo-only gate, and divergence between the two paths allows the same defect to persist in separate code paths.

A timing flake caused by slow plugin initialization is misdiagnosed as an image degrade because _assert_project_capabilities does not distinguish between 'fields not yet registered' and 'fields not offered by this image'.

The harness survives today only because it runs slower subsequent work (41-minute test suite) after readiness is declared, masking the underlying defect; the probe reveals the true state by querying immediately and observing a system-only inventory one second after serverInfo goes green.

Gerrit 1387 fixed only the probe script, creating the AC4 drift it was meant to prevent by leaving the harness unchanged on the weak serverInfo gate, so a shared definition and unified readiness predicate are required.
